# Usage Examples

BergAgents has three surfaces over the same Harness engine: the TUI, the Python API, and the web UI.

## TUI

```bash
python -m berg_agents --tui
```

Bare text runs a `generic` task; `/harness` (alias `/task`) runs it with explicit `harness` task type:

```
harness> refactor the login flow to use sessions
harness> /harness add retry logic to the sync worker
harness> /agents
harness> /stats
harness> /help
```

Slash commands (identical list and order in the web picker):

  | Command     | What it does                   |
  | ----------- | ------------------------------ |
  | `/help`     | Show all slash commands        |
  | `/agents`   | List registered agents         |
  | `/models`   | Show available models (web UI) |
  | `/stats`    | Learning statistics            |
  | `/tools`    | List available tools (web UI)  |
  | `/health`   | System health check (web UI)   |
  | `/history`  | Show session task transcript   |
  | `/memory`   | Memory information (web UI)    |
  | `/context`  | Show current context (web UI)  |
  | `/settings` | Show settings (web UI)         |
  | `/plugins`  | List plugins (web UI)          |
  | `/skills`   | List skills (web UI)           |
  | `/mcps`     | MCP server status (web UI)     |
  | `/harness`  | Run a task through the harness |
  | `/task`     | Same as `/harness`             |
  | `/clear`    | Clear the session              |

Commands marked "web UI" are listed in the TUI for parity but answered there with a web-only notice - the TUI only executes commands the Harness API can answer honestly.
Unknown commands warn and continue.

## Python API

```python
from berg_agents.app import BergAgentsApp

app = BergAgentsApp.create()

# Run a task
result = app.execute("Summarize the auth module", task_type="standard")
assert result["status"] in ("completed", "needs_human_review", "failed")

# Inspect the system
app.list_agents()  # agent catalog
app.get_learning_stats()  # task → model → outcome stats

# Custom .berg_config (highest precedence; falls back to bergagents.jsonc)
app = BergAgentsApp.create({"harness": {"enable_learning": False}})
```

Result shapes:

- `completed` - carries `selected_agent`, `model`, `tier`, `complexity`, `risk_level`, `confidence`
- `needs_human_review` - carries `review_reasons`; approve to resume with `hitl_decision` in task metadata
- `failed` - carries `error`, rendered inline (never a traceback)

## Web UI

```bash
python -m berg_agents --web --port 8001
# → http://127.0.0.1:8001
```

Type `/` to open the slash-command picker (same 16 commands as the TUI).
Agent, HITL, and learning panels update from the same task lifecycle the TUI renders.

### Frontend development

For UI work, run the backend and the Next.js dev server separately.
The
dev server is cross-origin, so it needs the backend URL at startup
(inlined by Next.js) - without it all `/api/*` calls 404 against
Next.js itself.
The backend allows CORS from `localhost`/`127.0.0.1`
ports 3000-3001.

```bash
python -m berg_agents --web --port 8001   # backend API
cd berg_agents/ui/webapp && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 npm run dev
# → http://localhost:3001 (3000 if free)
```

Production needs none of this: `python -m berg_agents --web` serves the
API and the static export from the same origin.

### API endpoints

  | Method   | Path                                                               | Purpose                                                  |
  | -------- | ------                                                             | ---------                                                |
  | POST     | `/api/harness`                                                     | Run a task, return the result dict                       |
  | POST     | `/api/harness/{thread_id}/stream`                                  | Start a streaming worker                                 |
  | GET      | `/api/harness/{thread_id}/events`                                  | SSE stream (`data-*` parts, AI SDK UI-message-stream v1) |
  | POST     | `/api/harness/{thread_id}/respond`                                 | Answer a HITL pause (approve / reject / edit)            |
  | GET      | `/api/learning-stats`                                              | Learning/outcome statistics                              |
  | GET/POST | `/api/providers`, `/api/providers/active`                          | Provider registry                                        |
  | GET      | `/api/agents`, `/api/agents/{name}`                                | Agent catalog                                            |
  | POST/GET | `/api/threads`, `/api/threads/{id}/cancel`, `/threads/{id}/export` | Threads                                                  |

## Human-in-the-Loop

When a task needs review, the Harness returns `needs_human_review`:

- **TUI**: the result panel shows the review reasons, then `Approve and resume? [y/N]:` - approval re-executes with `hitl_decision: approve` in metadata, anything else fails the task as rejected.
- **Web**: the HITL surface shows tool name + arguments with Approve / Reject / Edit (edit rewrites the args before the tool runs).

See [Tools](TOOLS.qmd) for which tools pause by default.
